messages.subject: Inconsistent results
parts:
Hi have 14 years of SCR data and I am trying to design a trap design with fewer traps for year 15.  I ran a simple model (D~session, g0~1,sigma~1) and got my parameter estimates.  Then I simulated a population (D=last 5 years averaged) and capture history (g0 and sigma from the true estimates) with my trap array for year 15.  I appended that last simulated capture history to the real capture history data in order to assess bias/precision for year 15.  I conducted 10 replicate fits of the real data (14 years) and the simulated data (1 year).
My problem is that I am getting inconsistent results among the simulation runs.  I can see where year 15 might be variable, but would the previous years be so affected with the addition of an additional year of simulated data whose parameters are based on the previous 14 years?

    out[[i]] <- predict(secr.fit(ch2, model = list(D~session),

out2 <- sapply(out, function(x) sapply(x, '[', 'D','estimate'))
plot(0,0,type='n', xlim=c(1,6), ylim=c(0,2), xlab='Time', ylab='Density')
apply(out2, 2, lines)
